Maruti Champli 
Fund Accounting Team Lead with 8 years of experience at State Street, 
managing 600+ funds across diverse structures including Hedge Funds, 
Private Equity, LP Funds, Commingled, Derivative, Domestic and Global 
Equity, and Fixed Income Funds. Expertise in NAV calculation and 
validation, trade booking, security pricing, cash and position reconciliation, 
dividend and interest income processing, expenses and capital activity 
administration. Demonstrated leadership in team management, client 
escalation resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), process improvement, and 
audit readiness. Skilled at mentoring high-performing teams, conducting 
team huddles, assisting in fund allocation, and implementing robust internal 
controls while ensuring SLA/KPI compliance. 
Work Experience 
Team Lead – Fund Accounting | State Street Corporation – 
Mumbai, India 
 
Team Leadership & Operational Management: 
 Lead and mentor a team of 8+ fund accountants managing 600+ funds, 
conducting daily team huddles, performance reviews, onboarding, and 
technical upskilling. 
 Allocate and prioritise daily and month -end tasks, ensuring efficient  
processing and timely completion of NAV cycles, reconciliations, and 
accounting activities. 
 Serve as primary escalation point for operational issues, providing 
guidance, troubleshooting, and resolution strategies. 
 Support managers in fund allocation, resource planning, and workflow 
optimization, ensuring high operational efficiency. 
Client & Stakeholder Management: 
 Handle client escalations, cash/position calls, and ad -hoc queries,  
coordinating with onshore/offshore teams to ensure SLA and regulatory 
compliance. 
 Prepare and present Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for operational 
discrepancies to management and clients. 
 Maintain robust client relationships by delivering accurate, timely, and 
comprehensive fund accounting reports. 
 Participate in internal and external audits, providing detailed 
reconciliations, documentation, and explanations as required. 
Technical & Fund Accounting Oversight: 
 Oversee monthly NAV calculation and validation for 600+ funds, ensuring 
completeness, accuracy, and adherence to accounting policies. 
 Perform security pricing as per Investment Manager (IM) statements, 
validating against approved market sources. 
 Book management fees, audit fees, and fund expenses, ensuring proper 
allocation and accurate posting in the ledger. 
 Process capital activities including subscriptions, redemptions, capital 
calls, and distributions. 
 Reconcile Investment Manager (IM) vs Custodian positions and cash, 
ensuring zero breaks. 
 Record dividend and interest income as per statements and process 
dividend reinvestments accurately. 
 Validate pricing tolerances, rates of return (ROR), and mark-to-market 
adjustments. 
 Review and resolve failed trades, outstanding income, and expense 
postings, maintaining clean trial balances. 
 Conduct daily cash and position reconciliations, ensuring general ledger 
and sub-ledger alignment. 
 Prepare and maintain mutual fund trackers, reconciliation trackers, and KPI 
dashboards for internal and client reporting. 
 Implement internal controls and risk mitigation measures, reducing 
operational errors and improving efficiency.
